text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work on my computer until noon, then take a short lunch break. In the afternoon, I often have meetings with my colleagues. Around six o'clock, I go for a run or do some exercise at the gym. In the evening, I cook dinner and relax by reading a book or watching a series. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced life.
